title: CADCraft save-loss report, LAYER visibility dimensions, and REGION carrier crosswalk
mode: Primary-source peer documentation and issue-index review, Autodesk DXF contract review, and local source/test crosswalk
scope: Classify CADCraft issue #1674's title-level REGION/layer-visibility report without over-attributing its route or failure cause.
Separate application-level REGION objects from DXF/DWG ACIS-bearing REGION/3DSOLID carriers.
Crosswalk layer-wide off/frozen/default-freeze/locked states against per-viewport frozen-layer references.
Add only a fast, implementation-ready group-70 test task to existing 7AN if local coverage is absent.

method.limitations: CADCraft issue #1674 search results exposed only the issue title and opened date; its body, drawing, exact build, output version, and route were unavailable. Repository README/gap inventory are mutable project statements. No peer behavior was independently reproduced. Autodesk documentation establishes DXF field meanings, not producer acceptance of a libdxfrw output.

sources.name: CADCraft issue #1674
sources.observed: The indexed title reports REGION objects not saved and layer visibility settings lost during DWG save; issue is shown as opened 2026-10-19. The body and sample were not retrieved.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer report title only; no route attribution, local reproduction, or format-rule evidence.

sources.name: CADCraft repository README and file-format gap inventory
sources.observed: README identifies ACadRust as the DWG read/write route and lists DWG writing to R2000. The gap inventory says CADCraft's own REGION application objects are saved as closed polylines without ACIS data.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Mutable project self-report, not an executed implementation result or an independent DWG codec.

sources.name: Autodesk LAYER DXF and ObjectARX layer-record contract
sources.observed: Group 62 sign expresses layer on/off; group 70 distinguishes frozen, default-frozen-in-new-viewports, locked and other flags; group 290 controls plotting. Entity group 60 is a separate object visibility field.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Normative/documented DXF semantics, not native acceptance of a generated libdxfrw file.

sources.name: Autodesk VIEWPORT and VPLAYER documentation
sources.observed: A VIEWPORT can list multiple frozen-layer object handles in repeated group 331 values; viewport-specific visibility is distinct from the layer-wide flags.
sources.evidence_ceiling: DXF field/command contract; no additional local issue established.

sources.name: Local libdxfrw source, generated tests, and plan
sources.observed: LAYER group 70 is handled through DRW_TableEntry flags; writeLayer emits it. DRW_Viewport retains frozenLayerHandles, writeViewport remaps/emits group 331, and existing generated layout controls check viewport layer targets and graph closure. Existing PAR-66 controls exercise signed layer off-state on a generated DWG CMC-to-DXF path. A focused generated LAYER group-70 1/2/4 flag vector was not located in the inspected owners.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Source and test-coverage audit only; no runtime mismatch or production defect reproduced.

sources.name: FreeCAD Draft DXF and DWG workflow documentation
sources.observed: Stock DWG import is converter-to-DXF followed by a selected DXF importer; stock DXF import does not consume embedded ACIS/SAT solids.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Consumer-route boundary only; cannot classify CADCraft #1674 or validate modeler semantics.

plan_impact.CADCraft_1674: Keep PEER_REPORT_ONLY / NOT_REPRODUCED until its body, sample, exact build, and route are available. Count its DWG path under ACadRust lineage.
plan_impact.REGION_terminology: Keep CADCraft application REGION/polyline abstraction separate from DXF inline modeler groups 1/3, legacy DWG SAT carriers, and R2013+ AcDs key/owner/SAB association under PAR-07/S3.7.
plan_impact.LAYER_visibility: Add a generated group-70 1/2/4/7 preservation vector under existing 7AN, paired independently with positive/negative group 62 and an entity sentinel. Reuse existing viewport group-331 graph tests; keep group 290 and entity group 60 distinct.
plan_impact.validation: Use existing DXF fixture executable/selector and owning CTest only after implementation; no full-suite, peer, FreeCAD, or native CAD run is needed for this bounded vector.

repository_state: Plan and research receipt updated in a broadly dirty shared worktree; no code, test source, persistent fixture, or support metadata was changed. Nothing staged or committed.
